author: Olli Järviniemi
title: Prime Order Density for 2 vs 3
statement: Definitions. For a positive integer n, let v_p(n) denote the largest integer v such that p^v | n. For p a prime and a not= 0 (mod p), let ord_p(a) denote the smallest positive integer o such that a^o = 1 (mod p). For x > 0, let ord_{p,x}(a) = prod_{q <= x, q prime} q^{v_q(ord_p(a))} * prod_{q > x, q prime} q^{v_q(p-1)}. Problem. Let S_x denote the set of primes p for which ord_{p,x}(2) > ord_{p,x}(3), and let d_x = |S_x| / |{p <= x : p is prime}|. Let d_\infty = lim_{x -> \infty} d_x. Compute \lfloor 10^6 d_\infty \rfloor.

author: A. Kite
title: Reducible Polynomial Monodromy and Degree 19 Evaluation
statement: Construct a degree 19 polynomial p(x) in C[x] such that X := {p(x) = p(y)} in P^1 x P^1 has at least 3 (but not all linear) irreducible components over C. Choose p(x) to be odd, monic, have real coefficients and linear coefficient -19 and calculate p(19).

author: Diego Chicharro
title: p-adic Continuity of Linear Recurrence
statement: Let a_n for n in Z be the sequence of integers satisfying the recurrence formula: a_n = 198130309625 a_{n-1} + 354973292077 a_{n-2} - 427761277677 a_{n-3} + 370639957 a_{n-4} with initial conditions a_i = i for 0 <= i <= 3. Find the smallest prime p = 4 (mod 7) for which the function Z -> Z given by n |-> a_n can be extended to a continuous function on Z_p.

author: Shreepranav Varma Enugandla
title: Orbits of 1000-dimensional S5 Representations
statement: Let M_{1000}^4 be the set of 4-tuples of invertible 1000 x 1000 matrices with coefficients in C. Let S subset M_{1000}^4 be the subset of all tuples (A_1, A_2, A_3, A_4) satisfying: A_i^2 = I for all 1 <= i <= 4; A_i A_j = A_j A_i if {3j-i, 3i-j} cap 5Z_{>0} = emptyset; and A_i A_j A_i^{-1} A_j^{-1} = A_j A_i if {3j-i, 3i-j} cap 5Z_{>0} != emptyset, where 5Z_{>0} = {5, 10, 15, ...}. The group G = GL(1000) acts on S by conjugation: B . (A_1, A_2, A_3, A_4) = (B A_1 B^{-1}, B A_2 B^{-1}, B A_3 B^{-1}, B A_4 B^{-1}). Find the number of orbits of this action, |S/G|.

author: Alex Gunning
title: Projective Points on Klein Quartic Curve over F_{5^18}
statement: How many nonzero points are there on x^3 y + y^3 z + z^3 x = 0 over F_{5^18} up to scaling (i.e. in P^2(F_{5^18}))?
